keep_playing_why: In B I was choosing a boat and lance, then reading a bar to time each pass, and by the third rival I was playing differently (ram Brisa with the Iron Tug, dodge waterspouts against Kite). Wins unlocked new yachts, which fed the next fight. A has one fresh idea (luring the right warden onto his plate) but much of its time was waiting on patrols and walking. Low confidence on A level 1: I could not see those frames.
better_made_why: B has layered audio (region music, stings, sampled hits and thunder), strong screen feedback on every hit, a readable HUD and a polished menu, dock and ladder. A is handsome with good writing, but its audio is sparse, the camera clipped into rock and my own character, and the stamp-rule text was easy to misread.
furthest_A: Level 1 The Sunken Court fully solved (block pushed, 3 stelae lit via 3 relayed mirrors, gate opened, cinematic). Level 2 The Checkpoint: took Mira's sun disc, stamped all 3 plates (crescent, waves, disc) after one 'PROCESSED' reset, reached objective 'Light the barrier lamp' (throw the disc through the crystal beam) but did not complete it.
furthest_B: Squall Cup ladder: beat Pip Tiller (first match, 2,000 pts), Bosun Barnacle (2,100), Doc Volta (2,100) and Kite Kowalski in Endless Squall (1,950, 'Unshaken', unlocked Skimmer Cat). Lost twice to Contessa Brisa (4th of 8 rivals) in the Quick Match, once with Iron Tug and once with Skimmer Cat, and was still fighting her when time ran out.
